programs.description: Mowgli, who is raised by Akela's wolf pack, goes on daily adventures with his friends, Baloo and Bagheera. He tries to help many animals who are in danger.
Seven young girls strive hard to protect the citizens of a magical land, Kaleidoscopia. Subsequently, with the help of their superpowers, they try to make the world a better place.
After discovering Thomas Edison's secret laboratory, Angie and his friends enter the world of science and unravel various phenomena with the help of Edison's ghost.
After losing his powers in a fight with his arch nemesis, Captain Fantastic now works undercover as a kindergarten teacher. Here he must help train a new generation of superpowered children.
